newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's Feb same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's Feb same-store sales rise.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said Thursday same-store sales for the four weeks ended March 1 were up 5.3 percent.
Comparable store sales exclude the discontinued electronics business.
Total sales for the month were up 17.2 percent to $133.0 million from $113.5 million.
"We are very pleased with our results in February," William Kellogg, chairman, said in a statement.
He added that Kohl's level of clearance merchandise in February was substantially below that of a year ago.
"We are particularly encouraged by the early selling of spring merchandise," Kellogg said.

Kohl's said it plans to open about 30 stores in 1997. In March, nine will open, including its entry into the Washington, D.C./Baltimore market, with stores in Ellicott City, Laurel, Bowie, Waldorf and Germantown, Md.; and Woodbridge, Fredericksburg and Springfield, Va.' and a new store in Evansville, Ind.
In April, nine stores will open in the Philadelphia market, one in Allentown, Pa., and one in Winchester, Va.
As of March 1, it operated 150 stores, up from 128 a year ago.
